assertions.rule: contract-registry operations and generated operation-registry rows form a one-to-one mapping by operation_id.
Every operation-registry operation_id appears exactly once as an OpenAPI operationId and no extra operationId exists.
Every operation not marked http_only_variant=true appears in the parsed non-HTTP binding artifact; every http_only_variant operation is absent.
Every request_schema and response_schema reference resolves to a registered schema artifact.
Every write operation declares idempotency_mechanism and retry_safe; every retry_safe=false operation also declares a machine-actionable uncertain_outcome recovery strategy.
Read-only query and resource-get operations do not invent an idempotency key contract.
